title: Phantom of the Opera
lyrics_synced:
[00:00.00] By music: Webber   lyrics: Stilgoe & HartGenerated by NoteWorthy Composer
[00:18.50] In sleep he sang to me, in dreams he came
[00:26.50] That voice which calls to me and speaks my name
[00:34.50] And do I dream again?  For now I find
[00:43.50] the Phantom of the Opera is there
[00:50.50] inside my mind.
[01:02.50] Sing once again with me our strange duet;
[01:10.50] my power over you grows stronger yet.
[01:18.50] And though you turn from me to glance behind,
[01:27.50] the Phantom of the Opera is there
[01:34.50] inside your mind.
[01:46.50] Those who have seen your face draw back in fear.
[01:54.50] I am the mask you wear . . . .
[01:58.50] It's me they hear.
[02:02.50] My/your spirit and your/my voice in one combined;
[02:11.50] The Phantom of the Opera is there inside your/my mind.
[02:38.50] In all your fantasies you always knew
[02:46.50] that man and mystery--
[02:50.50] --were both in you.
[02:54.50] And in this labyrinth where night is blind,
[03:03.50] The Phantom of the Opera is here/there,
[03:10.50] inside my/your mind.
[03:19.50] He's there, the Phantom of the Opera.
[03:28.00] Ah!  Ah!  Ah!
[03:52.00] Ah!  Ah!  Ah!  Ah!  Ah!
